## What I work on

I build the full chain from a camera's first frame to a product someone
actually clicks through: computer vision detectors and classifiers, the
datasets and training behind them, and the web front ends that put them in
front of people.

Core stack: YOLO (v8/11/26), PyTorch, OpenCV, Random Forest / classical ML,
Rust (MCP tooling), TypeScript, React, Next.js, Hono, PostgreSQL,
Cloudflare Workers/D1, Expo (React Native).

The work falls into four kinds, and the site's index filters by them:

1. Vision systems — camera in, decision out (PelakX, FireGuard, PPE
   Sentinel, Thief detection, Visual Intelligence Engine, PCB detection).
2. Research & algorithms — point-cloud curve reconstruction, explainable
   PCB classification.
3. AI developer tooling — Code Context Engine, NeuroMesh (contributor),
   AI Project Template.
4. Products & platforms — Homsayeh, UniVecity, Hospital Shift Intelligence,
   Melk AI, B2B Marketplace.

## Selected projects

- **Homsayeh — smart building platform** — neighbours register their
  building, verify each other and run charges, rules, repairs, votes,
  amenity bookings and guests together. Next.js 16 web + PWA, Expo Android
  app, Hono API on Cloudflare Workers + D1; FastAPI + PostgreSQL twin.
  Private repo; live: https://homsayeh.eshop3.pages.dev

- **UniVecity — faculty portal** — Persian RTL portal for Razi University's
  Faculty of Computer & Electrical Engineering: Hono API on Cloudflare and
  Docker/PostgreSQL, OIDC SSO, 68 automated tests. Private repo; live:
  https://razi-university.pages.dev

- **Hospital Shift Intelligence** — shift-management demo for Imam Reza
  Hospital, Kermanshah: fairness-aware scheduling engine, multi-step
  approvals, hash-chained audit log, RBAC, offline, Jalali calendar.
  Private repo; live: https://imam-reza-shift.1-parsa-karkooti.workers.dev

- **Code Context Engine** — local-first MCP context engine in Rust that
  sends AI coding agents folded evidence packets instead of whole files.
  https://github.com/ParsaVictor/code-context-engine

- **NeuroMesh (contributor)** — biomimetic MCP context engine; contributed
  project isolation, graph call resolution, TypeScript parsing and the 3D
  dashboard UX. https://github.com/pinoox/neuromesh

- **PelakX** — multi-country license-plate intelligence (ALPR): real-time
  detection, tracking, script-aware OCR and plate-category recognition,
  with deep support for Iran's plate grammar.
  https://github.com/ParsaVictor/pelakx-license-plate-detection

- **FireGuard** — real-time fire & smoke detection with hazard-state
  intelligence across three YOLO generations (v8/11/26), zero training.
  https://github.com/ParsaVictor/fireguard

- **PCB Component Detection** — YOLOv8 detection of electronic components
  on populated PCBs: 50 classes, 675k annotations.
  https://github.com/ParsaVictor/pcb-component-detection-yolov8

- **PCB Component Classifier** — explainable classification of electronic
  components: Random Forest over 33 hand-engineered CV features, 93.3%
  holdout accuracy, every prediction traceable to a readable decision path.
  https://github.com/ParsaVictor/pcb-component-classifier

- **Thief / Concealed-Face Detection** — real-time concealed-face detection
  for retail CCTV: pose-based orientation, occlusion-hardened tracking.
  https://github.com/ParsaVictor/thief-face-detection

- **Point Cloud Curve Reconstruction** — five peer-reviewed algorithms for
  3D point-cloud denoising and curve reconstruction, benchmarked on
  industrial 3D-printing scan data.
  https://github.com/ParsaVictor/point-cloud-curve-reconstruction

- **B2B International Marketplace** — international B2B marketplace on a
  modern full-stack architecture (Vue, Node.js, TypeScript).
  https://github.com/ParsaVictor/b2b-marketplace

- **Melk AI — Real Estate Platform** — AI-powered Persian real-estate
  platform, Next.js 16, RTL interface, Framer Motion.
  https://github.com/ParsaVictor/melkai-realestate-platform
